subject: Seatbelt: POC access & close playbook
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@medix.co>
To: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medix.co>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Seatbelt: POC access & close playbook

Hi Soojin / Ben,

We reviewed the MAP draft in yesterday's call and want to lock the technical prerequisites so we can hit a firm close date. For the POC we need the following confirmed in writing:
- organization seed (Redwood org invite + initial admin user)
- API keys and rotation plan (who will hold them; scoped key for test tenant)
- IP allowlist for our staging cluster (we'll provide ranges)
- VPC peering timeline and any required templates from Redwood

Target close for the POC contract: 2026-09-10. That gives our engineering team two weeks for validation after peering/keys are in place.

Can you provide the authoritative checklist and a proposed schedule (owner + ETA) for each item by end of day Monday? Procurement is standing by for the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Director of Integrations
Medix Solutions

Attachments: — none included in original email —

From: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@medix.co>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 07:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seatbelt: POC access & close playbook

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching our POC MAP checklist and the VPC peering template (small Excel + plain-text peering template) to make this prescriptive. Summary below with owners and dates so Procurement can plan DocuSign: 

- Org invite + admin user: owner: Soojin Lee (redwood) — ETA: 2026-08-25 EOD. Action: create org, invite elena@medix.co and an engineer (staging-admin@medix.co).
- Scoped API key + rotation note: owner: Ben Carter (redwood) — ETA: 2026-08-26 midday. Action: issue a scoped test key with expiration 30d; share secure link to key holder and set rotation reminder.
- IP allowlist: owner: Medix (Elena) — ETA: 2026-08-25 10:00 PT. Action: provide CIDR ranges for staging and CI runners.
- VPC peering: owner: Medix infra + Redwood infra (Soojin/Neha) — ETA: start: 2026-08-26, expected ESTABLISH: 2026-08-28 (pending firewall ACLs). Action: we provide peering template and the gateway ASN; Medix returns their side.

We will open a short validation window 08/29–09/02 and aim to mark the POC technical acceptance by 2026-09-03 if all passes. That preserves your target close 2026-09-10.

Next steps for Monday: Elena, can you share the staging CIDRs and the contact for your network engineer? Procurement: once we have the org invite and scoped key details, we'll mark the DocuSign envelope as ready to send.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_MAP_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB); VPC_peering_template.txt (text, 4KB)

Adding a quick technical note on API keys and IPs so the network team has exact values to test once they peer: 

- Scoped test key will be created in a test tenant (org id: rdw-test-2347) and will be marked for "staging" usage only. We'll provide a signed URL for secure retrieval.
- Redwood egress IPs for the staging cluster (for allowlist): 34.82.16.0/24, 34.83.120.0/22; we will confirm with infra but these are the ranges used for the peering handshake.
- For VPC peering, our template expects the peer to configure route propagation for the 10.40.0.0/16 range (Redwood assigns per-tenant subnets after peering).

If the Medix network engineer can confirm their CIDRs and a maintenance window on 08/28 (start 09:00 PT) we'll proceed with the peering orchestration.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
